prediction_coverage.work_assumption: Total rows constrain GEMM FLOPs, but the expert histogram and active weight reads remain those declared by the case.
prediction_coverage.mx_execution_assumption: Declared matrix compute-format work and operand-scale traffic; MX scale application and native instruction scheduling are not separately resolved. This does not infer an additional output epilogue from tensor descriptors.

prediction_coverage.basis: The declared program uses BF16 matrix service after an assumed fused dequantization; packed weight bytes and scale traffic are retained, but conversion and native MX execution have no physical program.

limitations: Buffer capacity does not prove valid routed FLOPs or active expert counts.
Native MXFP4 service/conversion coverage follows the declared program.

conditions: Existing case-declared programs; these costs are already part of model work.
Representative DP replica is conditional; the capture does not establish symmetric peer activity.
Native scalar arguments, cache contents, tiling and tensor ABI remain unobserved.
Unfused program sets are references and do not establish an atomic native kernel implementation.

quant.name: fp8_dynamic+mxfp4_experts
notes: ordinary linears use FP8 weights with the declared block scales; routed experts use FP4 group32 with E8M0 scales
activation_scheme=dynamic is a kernel path, not a global model dtype

default_mechanisms.basis: analytic resource programs; no measured dispatch or latency fit
default_mechanisms.gqa_kv_splits: default 1; explicit flash_attention_decode recipe may override
default_mechanisms.selection_boundary: family default; per-operator recipes retain priority
default_mechanisms.indexed_scratch: offchip; no inferred cache hit rate
default_mechanisms.sharedkv: SCFA source currently requires explicit prefill declarations
